facts.fact: 开场：Max 滑下 Aelindor 的膝盖坐到床沿，Caspian 把她散乱的白发别到耳后
facts.quote: Caspian tucked it behind my ear with tender fingers.

facts.fact: Max 报告：妹妹已不在 Crimson Ridge，被 Collector 掳走了
facts.quote: “My sister isn’t in Crimson Ridge anymore. The Collector has her.”

facts.fact: 幻象：玻璃盒中被割下的女人头颅开口说「他已查明你、你妹妹在 Haven」，随后双眼转纯黑，Max 在黑中看见 Missy 嘶喊 Max! Max! 随即被黑暗吞没
facts.quote: ‘He found out about you. He’s been searching for you for a very long time. Now he knows everything. He has your sister in the Haven.’

facts.fact: Aelindor 认出头颅是 Oracle：Xander 割下她的头、用黑魔法养活、自任她预言的唯一听众；Max 的描述与画像吻合
facts.quote: Severed her head, kept it alive with dark magic, and made himself the sole audience for her visions.

facts.fact: Drakken 推演绑匪路线：买通守卫带走小女孩，向西入 Nevada、南经 Arizona 到 New Mexico 边境、再进入 Texas 的 Xander 领地
facts.quote: They could go west into Nevada, south through Arizona to the New Mexico border, then into Xander’s territory in Texas.

facts.fact: Max 宣布不回基地，天一亮就南下独自穿越进 Haven 救妹妹
facts.quote: I won’t go back to the base, sirs. I’m heading south at first light to cross into the Haven.

facts.fact: Aelindor 定调：你不会独行；行动前先核实情报——确认 Missy 在 Haven、查清 Collector 关押她的确切地点
facts.quote: First, we confirm that Missy is in the Haven and not still at Crimson Ridge.

facts.fact: 章末：Aelindor 点出 Drakken 没把 Max 的铺盖卷带进来，请他去别处过夜；Drakken 无言掀帘走进黑夜
facts.quote: Then, without a word, he peeled himself off the tent pole, turned, and pushed through the flap into the dark.

relations: Max 是三人的 cadet（学员），称呼他们 sirs；Drakken 军衔在她之上，质询她逃兵的后果
Missy 是 Max 六岁半的妹妹（绰号 little viper），被 Collector 从 Crimson Ridge 掳走
Xander（the Collector）囚禁 Oracle：杀死她、割下头颅以黑魔法养活，独占她的预言；Oracle 渴望 Max 赐她死亡解脱
Oracle 主动向 Max 传象示警，又把 Max 的存在泄露给 Xander——两边下注为自己换取自由
Aelindor 与 Caspian 站在 Max 一边：Aelindor 宣布她不会独行，Caspian 要她信任他们、不盲闯敌境
Drakken 与 Delia 是恋人（Max 讥讽他们是 drama queen/drama king 绝配，Drakken 大笑回敬「You’re jealous」）
Max 能与有意识的金属 Coldiron 沟通；Coldiron 曾是她的藏身手段，离开矿山后不再庇护她
Max 的父母自幼训练她「先想后动、靠智谋活命」，并把她深藏躲过追查
Crimson Ridge 的围栏有结界、瞭望塔有人守，边境由 White Witch 的强化军驻守
numbers: In for four. Hold for four. Out for four.
four counts, hold, four counts out
I’d spent a decade planning my escape from Crimson Ridge
held Aelindor’s gaze for three heartbeats
My shoulders dropped half an inch
